replies.author: Alekpower
replies.body: Can't imagine gameplay on this being too great. Opposing teams would just bridge straight to the middle and whoever controls it will basically win, unless the other team has a single rusher who will most likely sneak off to the side. Possibly enlarge the void gap and the islands themselves. But, doubtless, it is a very pretty map.
